title: Xal'atath, the Shadow Priest
changeNote:
1.0.0 - Xal'atath, the Shadow Priest

The full release is here! The Beta label is retired.

- Play as Xal'atath with new matching artwork for combat, character selection, rest sites, defeat, and Heart victory.
- A floating, barefoot character with her signature cheek runes and independently animated shadow orbs above her shoulders.
- Voidform adds a bright purple aura and empowered orbs; Dispersion transforms her into shadow mist.
- Updated Workshop preview, character name, and flavor text.
- The complete 75-card and 11-relic class includes Devour Curse combos, Madness scaling, Haste, shields and healing, on-demand Voidform, and Combat Details run reports. Keep an eye out for legendary surprises.
- Existing character IDs and save compatibility are preserved. This release does not change card or relic balance from 0.1.5.

Thanks to everyone who played and shared feedback! Restart Slay the Spire after Steam downloads the update. Feedback and bug reports are welcome in the Workshop comments and discussions.
